label: real Kubernetes, CPU mock backends (no GPUs)

recovery.note: Requests in flight on a killed pod fail (expected). Gateway-pod kill errors come from kube-proxy still routing to the terminating pod until endpoints update.

hpa.note: Scale-down is not awaited (default 5-minute stabilisation window).
